items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 25 at 2:40AM EDT until October 26 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 7 to 10 ft.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
